- Added `mailtm-up` / `mailtm-down` subcommands to the deployment-test orchestrator (`apps/minds_admin/scripts/test_deployments.py`). They mint and delete a per-run disposable mail.tm mailbox and persist its state (address, account id, JWT, run id) to a JSON file. This lets the CI job (which builds its ci env in a separate job from the one that runs pytest) provision the mailbox the realistic-signup verification test needs and export `MAILTM_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS` / `MAILTM_ACCOUNT_JWT` to the pytest step, mirroring what the local `run` / `services-against` flows already do inline.
